name: OptiC's Warehouse Loft
description: Requires ProBuilder (tested with 6.1.2). A customisable warehouse loft scene with large windows, mezzanine, materials and baked lighting. Install ProBuilder before importing this package.
license: Custom noncommercial sharing terms; see licence notes
testNotes: Maintainer check: Unity 6000.3.21f1 / URP 17.3.0 with ProBuilder 6.1.2. Scene opened; 515 objects, 409 renderers, zero missing scripts and zero missing/unsupported material slots after installing ProBuilder. Initial test without ProBuilder reported 814 missing script components. No scene save, rendered visual review, build or device test performed. Contributor reports Quest 2, Quest 3, PC VR and PC testing with no known issues.
usage: REQUIRED: Install ProBuilder before importing. In a fresh Unity 6000.3.21f1 URP project, open Package Manager, select Unity Registry, search for ProBuilder and install it (tested: 6.1.2). Alternatively use Install package by name with com.unity.probuilder and version 6.1.2. Wait for installation and compilation to finish. Open Source to download the ZIP, extract it, and import the enclosed unitypackage. Then open Assets/Scenes/Loft.unity. Without ProBuilder this supplied scene has missing script components. Download and import are manual.
